An abandoned camp is a small structure consisting of a campsite and wool tent with chests, barrels, and copper chests that generates in various Overworld surface biomes. Its appearance can be varied, such as being covered in leaves or featuring a crop farm nearby. The loot inside the chests can have explorer maps for various structures, such as other abandoned camps, trial chambers, and ancient cities.

Description

[edit | edit source]

Abandoned camps can generate in eighteen surface biomes in the Overworld, featuring tents made of white wool stairs with an array of chests, barrels, straw beds, cushions, and other utility blocks inside. Rarely, an oxidized copper chest can be found with more valuable loot than the standard containers, often being hidden under other blocks.

The floor of the tent and surrounding ground are composed of dirt, gravel, and path blocks, and nearby the tent is an unlit campfire along with a chest or a barrel. Cobwebs and leaves sometimes replace the wool stairs that make up the tent, giving it an abandoned appearance. Other features can sometimes generate around the tent, such as a tree or small crop farm. The fences supporting the tent differ depending on the biome. For example, a tent that generates in a pale garden uses pale oak fences.

Generation

[edit | edit source]

Abandoned camps generate in the following biomes:

  • Bamboo Jungle
  • Birch Forest
  • Cherry Grove
  • Dappled Forest
  • Flower Forest
  • Forest
  • Meadow
  • Old Growth Birch Forest
  • Old Growth Pine Taiga
  • Old Growth Spruce Taiga
  • Pale Garden
  • Savanna
  • Snowy Taiga
  • Sparse Jungle
  • Swamp
  • Taiga
  • Windswept Forest
  • Wooded Badlands

The generation of abandoned camps follows a grid of 37×37 chunk regions centered on the world origin. Each region contains a single generation attempt at a random location within the region; if the selected location is not within a valid biome, the camp does not generate.

Assuming invalid biomes do not cancel generation, abandoned camps are spaced a minimum of 8 chunks and a maximum of 60 chunks apart. The average distance between two neighboring camps is therefore 34 chunks.[verify]

Abandoned camps are one of the only structures that generate on the same locations in Java Edition and Bedrock Edition.

Structure

[edit | edit source]

An abandoned camp consists of a tent and a campsite generated in front of it. The tent variant is determined by the biome in which the camp generates. There are ten variants of the tent per biome, making each tent variation have a weight of 1⁄10 (10%). The campsite variant is selected from a pool of 45 default variants and 4 additional biome-specific variants corresponding to the biome in which the camp generates, with each variant having an equal probability of being chosen. The chance for one to be selected is 1⁄49 (2.04%) for each variant.

As a result, a total of 8,820 unique abandoned camp configurations are possible.

History

[edit | edit source]

Announcement

[edit | edit source]
May 30, 2026 Abandoned camps are announced at Minecraft Live – May 2026.
An Instagram post revealed that cauldrons and oxidized copper golem statues can spawn in abandoned camps.[1]
Some blocks that were not shown in Minecraft Live that can spawn in abandoned camps but were shown off to content creators in a private play session include cherry leaves, mossy cobblestone walls, potatoes, stone, and wheat.[2]
May 31, 2026 Some details about abandoned camps were revealed that weren't showcased at Minecraft Live. An abandoned camp's appearance can be varied, such as being covered in leaves or featuring a crop farm nearby.

Java Edition

[edit | edit source]
Java Edition
26.3snap1 Added abandoned camps.
snap3 Straw beds and cushions now generate as part of abandoned camps.
Redesigned some tents and campsites (see /Structure history).
Most trees in abandoned camps are now procedurally generated.
"tent_cherry_grove_4" is no longer the only tent to contain an oxidized copper chest.
snap6 Added a new campsite variant for each biome.
Some minor tweaks to abandoned camp structures have been done.
snap7 Updated loot table for the abandoned camp barrel.
Replaced firework rocket with gunpowder in chest loot table.
Added explorer maps to loot tables.
snap8 They now generate slightly further from each other, with a spacing of 37 chunks instead of 34.
pre1 Abandoned camps no longer contain mycelium.

Experiment
Drop 3 of 2026		Preview 26.50.20 Cushions now generate in abandoned camps.
campsite_default_special_8 no longer always generates with 7 oxidized copper chains, 7 copper ingots, 2 iron ingots, 1 gold ingot, and 1 iron leggings.
26.50Preview 26.50.22 All features from the "Drop 3 of 2026" experiment have been fully implemented.
Upcoming Bedrock Edition
26.60Preview 26.60.21 Abandoned camps no longer contain mycelium.
Abandoned camps no longer contains singular coarse dirt blocks.

Issues

[edit | edit source]

Issues relating to "Abandoned Camp" are maintained on the bug tracker. Issues should be reported and viewed there.

Notes

[edit | edit source]
  1. ↑ Buried chests that are partially visible from the surface, such as those that can be seen through leaves, are omitted.
  2. ↑ a b Trees and bamboo are procedurally generated after the structure piece is placed. They are included in some renders to represent the final in-game appearance.
  3. ↑ a b c d e f g h Unlike most other structure pieces, the tree in this one is part of the structure itself and does not generate procedurally after the structure piece is placed.
